# netcup_scp_user_vlan (Resource)

Updates the name of an existing netcup SCP user VLAN. VLANs cannot be created or deleted through the API.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "netcup_scp_user_vlan" "example" {
  user_id = 12345
  vlan_id = 67890
  name    = "my-vlan"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) New name for the VLAN.
- `user_id` (Number) ID of the user that owns the VLAN.
- `vlan_id` (Number) ID of the VLAN to update.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) Terraform identifier for this VLAN.
